other_findings: Left out: 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28, which GA4 may still be processing (1,190 sessions). Those days already show 102 (not set) sessions in Unassigned and 21 Cross-network sessions; re-run once both days are 2 days old.

Campaign names with capitals or spaces reach GA4 as they are: Free Trial | Salon Owners, Search | Appointment reminders, Search | Brand, Search | Online booking software, Search | Salon booking, Welcome_Series. The convention below fixes them for new campaigns.
Google Ads: 0 of 24 ads and 0 of 8 sitelinks put utm_ in the final URL; 0 of 12 ad groups and 0 of 140 keywords set their own template.
Meta inventory: 17 of the 42 creatives no live ad uses have no URL tags. Not scored; tag them if you reuse them.
The property uses only GA4's default channel group, so no custom rule maps the unknown mediums today.
TikTok: GA4 shows tiktok / paid_social on 520 sessions with a campaign that follows the convention. TikTok Ads isn't one of the platforms this skill reads, so its own settings weren't checked.

rules.utm_source: platform or partner, lowercase, one spelling: google, facebook, instagram, linkedin, tiktok, klaviyo, the partner's domain
rules.utm_medium: cpc for search ads, paid_social for Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads, email for Klaviyo, referral for partners and directories, audio for podcasts
rules.utm_campaign: <goal>_<offer-or-theme>_<yyyymm>: lowercase, - between words, _ between parts, as the LinkedIn and TikTok campaigns already do (demo_clinic-managers_202609)

templates.meta_url_tags: utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}&utm_content={{ad.name}}&utm_term={{adset.name}} (rename new Meta campaigns to the campaign pattern first, for example free-trial_salon-owners_202611)
templates.google_ads: keep auto-tagging and the account suffix utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign={campaignid}; no campaign templates
